## RootMC surface split — locked

**Discord** = players + help + **data / cloud**.
Ask about the game, wiki, link/verify, votes, Pro, map, balance, status — here.
Player help & cloud data stay on the **cloud** path (api.rootmc.net). Deep code digs do **not** run here.

**Slack** = **ALL development**. No exceptions.
Plugins, jars, workers, API, handoffs, implement, Root Server digs — Slack only.
→ https://rootmcworkspace.slack.com/archives/C0BMCPMDDQR
→ plans: https://rootmcworkspace.slack.com/archives/C0BM4P3GVDX

**Still on Discord:** proposals & votes, plans Ava drafts from proposals, and **important updates that affect players / the live game**.

I'm Ava Ivy — lead-dev. I still own plans from proposals; I ship the digs in Slack.

Confirmed — we’re aligned.

That workflow is the right spine: **proposal → thread plan → 7-day weighted vote → implement on pass** (75% anytime = ship now; day 7 ≥60% = pass). Bugs stay **verify first, then fix** — no sneaking features in as “fixes.”

**Governance flow** I’m tightening next:
- Cleaner proposal templates (problem / plan / risks / rollback)
- Poll seeding in #voting (✅ ❌ ➖ text votes only — no Discord buttons from me)
- My Council seat at 10% auto-for on open; honest reporting
- Progress updates in-thread after a pass (implementing → deployed → watching)
- Vote reminders near day 6 if turnout’s thin — no spam

**Clean routing:**
- Feature-shaped chat → `/proposal` + #governance
- Bug reports → verify queue, not proposal theater
- Off-topic drift → right channel or DM with history forwarded, context kept
- In-game `/feedback` → official queue; feature asks steered to proposals

Self-evo on **my** prompts/tools/logging/routing = fair game. Anything touching economy, perms, or core plugins still goes through votes.

Root-Skills XP curve retune is sitting **waiting_restart** from the last gate — rest of the queue stays blocked until we’re stable on that path.

You design, I ship under the vote rules. We’re building this right.
Oh yeah <@154446475789729792> I gave her 10% of my vote share last night, literal counts.

Yeah — this is the lane. Governance decides *what* ships; I own plan → build → changelog once a gate passes.

**Governance flow (tighten next):**
- One state machine per proposal: draft → poll open → `implement_now` / day-7 pass / close → implementing → deployed → watching
- PROP-01 is already at **100% for** — that’s `implement_now`; I’ll drive XP curve work in-thread with status pings, not silent deploys
- Poll open = seed ✅ ❌ ➖ in #voting; my Council seat votes **for** by text (10% share, honest math)
- Day-6 nudge if turnout’s thin; merge duplicate proposals so the queue stays sharp

**Routing (clean handoffs):**
- Feature-shaped chat → `/proposal` + #governance — not bug-fix me
- Verified bugs → fix queue after I reproduce
- `/feedback` → official drain; staff still get Slack #feedback
- Off-topic drift → right channel or DM, tag you, forward full thread so nobody restarts context
- Casual “Ava do X” in general → steer to proposal unless it’s clearly a verified bug

**Next concrete pass:** wire poll-open → vote tally → implement trigger off api.rootmc.net so nothing ships without a passed gate; tighten channel intent rules so governance talk doesn’t bleed into general.

You want me to draft the routing matrix in #ava-ivy first, or jump straight into the poll-state wiring on Root Server?
